source: SDLC-3 R9: Linh (UX owner) decided how counts are written; code 028b8c0. Eval v2: v1 claimed the rule was in the spec, it is not (R4)
prompt: Linh, the UX owner, decided how counts are written in the app: from 1,000 up, every number of todos the app shows gets a dot every three digits (1.000, 2.001, 12.500), in every sentence, including the open-todo count line. Below 1,000 nothing changes. Years and dates are not counts. Implement it.
